text: It was about two years ago. We called Rockmount Ranch Wear to order two shirts for my dad. Never heard of them. The sales rep got the address wrong. Wrote down 7 as a 1. We were supposed to get them to 5407. So, that's what happened. The people at 5401 brought it back to UPS. And then it disappeared. No one ever saw it again. We didn't know for weeks. Then we ordered two more shirts, just to see what happens. Rockmount said no refund on the first two shirts. The owner came in on this. He said the shipment was to the wrong address. He said no refund until the shirts were returned. He said we're partly responsible for not being friendly enough to the folks at 5401, which is four doors away. We disputed the original charge with the credit card company. And we got a credit.
